title: Rav Acha bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “Rabbi Shimon Chasida said” — so it is in Berakhot 3b. Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rav Chana bar Bizna, who always speaks in his name, as in Berakhot 7a and Menachot 35b; and so it is in Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Berakhot 3b passage reads Rav Acha bar Bizna reporting Rabbi Shimon Chasida; Berakhot 7a and Menachot 35b instead read Rav Chana bar Bizna reporting Rabbi Shimon Chasida. Hyman calls Acha a textual error and says it should read Chana. His “always” wording and his reports about Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim remain attributed claims, without a fresh apparatus census or an identity merge.
